subtitle_sp_post_afco/sp_post_afco_bori_: You... Take care of each other...
subtitle_sp_post_afco/sp_post_afco_poli_: I should have been here Papasha...
Papasha... Tell Mama I’m off to save Misha. As usual.
subtitle_sp_post_afco/sp_post_afco_stei_: Your soldiers will not hold the Post Office. My forces will crush this pitiful resistance!
subtitle_sp_post_afst/sp_post_afst_stei_: All civilians must report for processing immediately.
All Russians are going to be captured or killed!
Our forces are clearly superior, do not throw your lives away.
Stalingrad, you are going to fall to me!
Your city belongs to the Third Reich, already!
subtitle_sp_post_aphr/sp_post_aphr_lala_: I don’t have any. I swear it!
I have nothing that would be of value to you!
Please. Let me go. I don't have anything.
Please, we haven’t done anything to you. Just leave. Please!
Why would I lie to you? Just leave me alone!
subtitle_sp_post_aphr/sp_post_aphr_snz1_: I’m done with this. Give us your gold, or we take you outside.
Just give us your valuables and we’ll leave you alone.
Just give us your valuables and we will leave you alone.
She’s probably right. This place is a shithole.
We’re not going to find anything good here. Waste of our time.
subtitle_sp_post_aphr/sp_post_aphr_snz2_: Bullshit lies from gutter trash. So we’re starting over.
C’mon, don’t make us hurt you. Just tell us where we can find what we want.
Get in there. We'll deal with you after.
subtitle_sp_post_aphr/sp_post_aphr_snz3_: Did you hear me? What are you doing?
He's been stabbed! There's someone here!
Hey! I said what'd you find?
subtitle_sp_post_apre/sp_post_apre_lala_: I don’t know any. I swear it.
subtitle_sp_post_apre/sp_post_apre_poli_: You have to leave Stalingrad. Now!
subtitle_sp_post_apre/sp_post_apre_snz2_: Bullshit lies from a gutter trash. Grab her.
subtitle_sp_post_bowa/sp_post_bowa_bori_: You help your country... more than you know... and you make your old man proud...
subtitle_sp_post_core/sp_post_core_mish_: Blyat, I'm not receiving... Bozhe, I hope you're listening to me for once. We're pinned down in the crater by the trolley.
Blyat, where did all these Germans come from?!
Careful where you're shooting!
Don't shoot the sewer opening, Polina! That's us!
Blyat, that's us in front of the sewer! Shoot the Germans!
Don't throw these molotovs too close!
Don't throw molotovs at the sewer! That's where we are.
Find a way down!
Get down to the street!
Getting a little hot down here! Careful with those molotovs!
Polina, watch your molotovs!
Watch your aim, sestra, you're going to roast us in the crater!
Good shot!
Blyn, you're even better than Papasha!
Papasha would be proud!
Glad it's you up there and not me!
I wish I could shoot like that.
If only Papasha could see you use that thing!
Hey, don't shoot us, Polina! We're the ones in the crater!
Hey, hey, hey, watch who you're shooting!
Sestra, shoot them, not us!
Hey Polina, if there are any molotovs up there, you should share them with the Nazis.
Did you find a crate of molotovs up there? It might help.
If there are molotovs, now's the time, Polina!
How many of those molotovs do you have left?
I see some scaffolding on the side of the building you can use!
More coming from the right, Polina!
More Germans behind us! Other side of the crater!
Okay everyone, move to the sewer now! Polina, keep them covered!
Partisans, move, now! Polina's got his attention!
Polina! Polina, can you hear me? I'm on the radio!
Polina, if you can hear me, find the radio!
I found a radio! Polina, do you see the one on the roof? Can you hear me?
Polina, don't forget about Papasha's rifle!
Polina, get down here and meet me at the sewer!
Polina, I think they're trying to flank you on the rooftops!
Polina! The hotel!
Rrraaghh! German scum!
Get out of my way—!
Mother Russia will keep you.
Davay! Davay! We're getting closer!
There's nothing more you can do up there!
They're up in the windows!
We're getting shot from above! The windows!
They have us pinned from above the hotel lobby!
Waiting for your first shot before we start moving to the sewer.
Polina, we’ll start for the sewer on your signal.
Ready to move to the sewer when you open fire.
Watch it, that's my head!
Hey, Polina, that's me you're firing at!
Careful you almost hit me!
Welcome to Stalingrad, mudak.
Good throw, sestra!
Noo dayesh!
We need a minute to get the sewer open!
We're getting swarmed! Keep those Nazis off us, sestra!
We need cover fire, Polina!
We can't hold out here much longer, Polina! We need a clear path!
subtitle_sp_post_core/sp_post_core_stei_: None of you are leaving this square alive.
Russian sniper! Lay down your weapon and surrender.
Stalingrad belongs to the Reich! Surrender now or face death!
There is nothing left of the Red Army! No one is coming to save you. Give yourselves up… or die.
You are surrounded, Ivan! Accept your defeat!
subtitle_sp_post_covi/sp_post_covi_bori_: I'll shoot every one of you myself!
Stalingrad will never surrender, German scum!
You Nazi bastards! I'll kill you all!
subtitle_sp_post_covi/sp_post_covi_sns4_: Oberst Steiner, we found Banditen trash holed up here. Place full of ordinance.
subtitle_sp_post_covi/sp_post_covi_snz2_: Stupid old man. You're coming with us.
subtitle_sp_post_covi/sp_post_covi_stei_: Search everywhere. Flush out the Russian vermin... Round them up.
That was a mistake, old man.
subtitle_sp_post_dgap/sp_post_dgap_snz3_: It’s all garbage, there’s nothing good here at all--
Nothing good in here. There never is.--
subtitle_sp_post_disa/sp_post_disa_snz1_: Through this door! They're in here, move out of the way!
subtitle_sp_post_fisq/sp_post_fisq_bori_: The Red Army will end you all, just wait.
You’ll never take the motherland you ublyoudki!
You think you can take Stalingrad?
subtitle_sp_post_fisq/sp_post_fisq_snz1_: The Red Army can’t save you now, old man.
These are all the survivors in the building.
subtitle_sp_post_fisq/sp_post_fisq_stei_: I have no need for useless citizens.
subtitle_sp_post_loas/sp_post_loas_stei_: We will burn your city to the ground.
subtitle_sp_post_ples/sp_post_ples_mish_: He would be proud of you.
If you're sure, sestra. Maybe you can reach the roof climbing up there.
I know there were soldiers defending on the roof. They had a radio... there might be supplies too.
I know, you've always been a better shot than me...
I think I can boost you from here.
Okay, ryebyata. Once we're out on the street, stay hidden until Polina is in position.
That should get you to the roof, I'll give you a boost.
There's an exit here. We could make a run for the sewers, but the Germans are blocking the courtyard.
Syestryonka, we need to figure this out.
subtitle_sp_post_ples/sp_post_ples_poli_: Get our people to the sewer.
He would be proud of us.
I'll find a good place to cover you.
Alright. I’ll lay down cover fire from there while you get our people to the sewers.
I'll lay down fire from the roof.
It'll be tough... Do you have any extra supplies? Weapons? Anything I can use?
Misha, focus. How can we escape to the river?
Papa is with me now. And I know he wouldn't want us to die in this post office to a bunch of ublyudki.
Misha, we need to get to the Volga. How do we get out of this building?
subtitle_sp_post_poap/sp_post_poap_mish_: No use in keeping us alive.
You can all go to hell.
subtitle_sp_post_poap/sp_post_poap_snzo_: Be careful or we will make an example of you.
Oberst Steiner will want to interrogate them before we execute.
Round up everyone you see in this building!
You will change your mind once Steiner is done with you.
subtitle_sp_post_poap/sp_post_poap_stei_: If you continue to resist, we will bring the building down.
Surrender, and you will be shown mercy.
The longer you fight, the more devastating your defeat.
subtitle_sp_post_poas/sp_post_poas_mish_: I think they're dead! Can you cut us free now?
It's too dangerous! Deal with the Germans!
Natsistskiymusor, the partisans will never let you escape Stalingrad.
Oh thank God... come cut us free, quick!
Come on, sestra, we have to get out of here!
Polina, watch out! Don't get killed!
The last ones are over here!
There's still too many of them around!
subtitle_sp_post_poas/sp_post_poas_snz1_: Steiner is coming to interrogate these Russians personally.
We'll take Stalingrad by the end of the month.
subtitle_sp_post_poas/sp_post_poas_snz2_: You're too generous. Stalingrad will surrender by the end of the week.
subtitle_sp_post_poas/sp_post_poas_snz3_: Get inside and crush the partisans!
Why do I have to patrol?
Why is Steiner making us wait...
subtitle_sp_post_poas/sp_post_poas_snzo_: Don’t let anyone leave this building!
Don’t try and be a hero.
If you tell me what the Red Army has planned, I’ll make things easier for you.
Look around! Your city is in ruins. There is nothing left to save.
Maybe you’re not so stupid after all.
No one is coming to save you.
Steiner will decide what to do with you.
Where are the rest of your insurgents?
subtitle_sp_post_rebr/sp_post_rebr_mish_: Gospodi… I was so scared that you were--
subtitle_sp_post_rebr/sp_post_rebr_poli_: If we stay here much longer, we’re trapped.
Me?! You’re the one tied up!
We don’t have time for this.
We have to get your recruits out of here.
subtitle_sp_post_rese/sp_post_rese_mish_: We can’t keep this sewer open forever, sestra, come on!
There’s too many, Polina! Just run!
subtitle_sp_post_rese/sp_post_rese_stei_: There is no hole you can hide in, vermin.
Running won't save you. I will hunt you all down.
subtitle_sp_post_skro/sp_post_skro_snz3_: Why do I always end up in the slums? Nothing good here...
